record_type_quote: Recently, a Chinese genomewide association study (GWAS) identified four autosomal single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) loci as being significantly associated with risk factors for nonobstructive azoospermia (NOA; P < 5 × 10(-8)). In the present study, we performed a replication study on two Japanese cohorts from different institutions in order to evaluate whether SNP loci are associated with NOA.

targets.outcome_quote: None of the SNPs was significantly associated with NOA (P > 0.05).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original four significant associations were retested, and none was significant. Three directional agreements are noted, but do not establish confirmation. Full discussion unavailable; uncertainty retained.
